description:
[Wicked Registry] Free pre-payment check of ANY tool URL before your agent pays it. Makes one live unpaid GET to the https URL and combines it with the registry score if listed. Returns a verdict (ok, caution, avoid, unknown) with reasons, the registry score/uptime/latency, and the live x402 challenge (price, network, payTo, whether it is well-formed). Never pays. Rate limited to 20/min per IP.

Use when you are about to call or pay a tool at a URL and want a free live check plus its registry score and a verdict first. Not for browsing or ranking tools (use registry_search_tools), or a score-only lookup (use registry_lookup).

Behavior: read-only.

url.description: Full https URL of the tool endpoint you are about to call (default port, no credentials, public hostname).

name: registry_check_tool
